title: platform-standup-2026-03-23
content:
Attendees: Aisha, Tomás, Lena, Michael, Priya (quick sync; others deferred)

Summary (high level):
- Quick check-in on control plane rollout, routing policy work, auth token refresh bug, and quota recalculation job.
- Focus this week: finish canary for control-plane leader election change, unblock routing e2e tests, patch auth refresh regression, and stabilize quota job memory usage.

Control Plane:
- Aisha: Leader election change (move from etcd-3.5 default to asymmetric lease) is running in staging canary (10% of control-plane pods). Observed ~12% reduction in leader churn during bursty traffic tests.
  - PR: platform#2142 (linked). Ready for 48h canary, then widen if no regressions.
  - Still seeing one pod with OOM when mixing heavy API list calls + KV cache warmup; root cause points to our control-plane metrics heap. Working with Tomás to add targeted instrumentation.
  - TODO: add heap snapshot and a short-lived memory guard (quota) for that leader pod. Assigned to Aisha/Tomás. Target: 2026-03-25.

Routing & Smart Routing Policies:
- Tomás: Routing policy engine refactor (rule evaluator extraction) merged to staging, but e2e routing tests failing intermittently (sticky session TTL mis-match).
  - Hypothesis: old session affinity headers still present for a subset of legacy clients; evaluator treats absent header as strong affinity. Need to default to soft-affinity when header missing.
  - Action: add fallback in evaluator + add unit test for header-absent case. PR ready (WIP). Estimated merge 2026-03-24 if tests stable.
  - Note: performance looks neutral after refactor (no throughput regression).

Auth & Token Management:
- Lena: Found regression in auth token refresh flow introduced by last-week change to token caching (INF-3421). Some long-running requests (streaming) hit a stale token and get 401 mid-stream.
  - Hotfix: revert cache TTL behavior for streaming tokens; landed to staging today.
  - Need to add integration test to simulate long-lived streaming + mid-stream token rotation. Michael will add the harness. Target: 2026-03-26.
  - Security note: discussed with Priya to validate revocation tests for customer-managed KMS. No customer impact found so far.

Quotas & Billing Metering:
- Michael: Quota recalculation job (daily) using new algorithm is running but spikes memory on large customer partitions. Identified that the in-memory index grows unexpectedly for customers with many routes.
  - Short-term: throttle parallelism and stream partitions from disk (patch submitted).
  - Long-term: move index to on-disk LRU-backed structure (design doc in Confluence).
  - Impact: customers with >100k routes may see delayed quota updates by 1 day until we stabilize. Flagged to Customer Success for heads-up.

Observability / Console:
- Priya: Dashboard for canary leader-election metrics added to Console. Still tuning alerts to avoid noise for minor transient churn.
  - Need to add an alert for OOM spikes in control-plane pods during canary to auto-notify platform-eng channel. Action item for Priya/Tomás.

Blockers / Risks:
- Control-plane OOM under specific workload (Aisha/Tomás) — blocker for widening canary.
- Routing sticky-session test flakes — blocks routing refactor merge and dependent canary traffic split.
- Quota job memory spikes — potential customer-facing delay; CS notified.
- Auth streaming token regression fixed in staging but needs robust integration test before prod revert fully accepted.

Action Items (owners & due dates):
- Aisha/Tomás: Add heap snapshot + memory guard and run extended canary (48h). Due 2026-03-25.
- Tomás: Complete routing evaluator fallback PR + add unit tests. Due 2026-03-24.
- Michael: Harden quota recalculation job to stream partitions + submit patch to staging. Due 2026-03-24.
- Lena/Michael: Add streaming token rotation integration test harness. Due 2026-03-26.
- Priya: Add OOM spike alert to Console and link to runbook. Due 2026-03-24.
- Aisha: Draft customer note for CS about quota delay for large route customers. Due 2026-03-24.

Notes / Misc:
- Linked Confluence doc contains control-plane design notes and memory profiling checklist (linked_artifacts).
- We discussed rolling back leader election change entirely if canary shows increased error rates after memory guard — fallback plan documented.
- Quick reminder: infra on-call (SRE) to keep an eye on control-plane canary and routing test run during the weekend.

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Investigate whether quota job memory issue correlates with specific route naming patterns (prefixes).
- Explore A/B of soft-affinity default for legacy clients across small sample of customers.
- Post-mortem template for auth token regression (if it makes prod) to include timeline + detection gaps.

Next standup: 2026-03-24 morning sync (15 min) — focus: canary status + routing test stability

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep canary small until memory guard in place.
- Refs: PLAT-1987 is the leader-election task, INF-3421 is the token cache change.
- Slack threads: #plat-control-plane, #plat-routing for updates.
